## 📋 Pull Request Description

### 🎯 What does this PR do?
Briefly describe the changes in this pull request.

### 🔗 Related Issues
Fixes #(issue number)
Relates to #(issue number)

### 🧪 Testing
- [ ] All existing tests pass
- [ ] New tests added for new functionality
- [ ] BDD scenarios updated (if applicable)
- [ ] Integration tests added (if applicable)
- [ ] Manual testing completed

### 📚 Documentation
- [ ] XML documentation updated
- [ ] Swagger annotations added/updated
- [ ] README updated (if needed)
- [ ] API examples provided

### 🔄 Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Code refactoring

### 🚨 Breaking Changes
If this is a breaking change, describe what changes users need to make:
- API endpoint changes
- Request/response format changes
- Configuration changes
- Dependency updates

### 📊 API Changes
If this PR includes API changes, provide examples:

#### New Endpoints
```http
GET /api/new-endpoint
```

#### Modified Endpoints
```http
# Before
GET /api/old-format

# After  
GET /api/new-format
```

### 🧩 Implementation Details
Describe the technical implementation:
- Architecture decisions
- Design patterns used
- Dependencies added/removed
- Performance considerations

### 📸 Screenshots (if applicable)
Add screenshots of new features or UI changes.

### 🎯 Review Focus Areas
Please pay special attention to:
- [ ] Error handling
- [ ] Performance impact
- [ ] Security considerations
- [ ] API design consistency
- [ ] Test coverage

### 📋 Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project's coding standards
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published

### 🤝 Additional Notes
Any additional information that reviewers should know about this PR.
